messages:
Aisha Khan: FYI - Prospect (Tier-1 bank) requires a strictly air-gapped POC. Constraints: no outbound, no jumpbox, customer-managed CA rotations, HSM-backed keys, and only physical media (USB) for patch delivery. They want model pinning and an offline activation token. Can we support?

Tim Park: Clarify: full image vs delta-only? And are we allowed any remote support if customer approves for a session?

Aisha Khan: They insist on physical-only artifact delivery. Remote sessions are blocked unless we embed an on-site SOW for engineers.

Maya Li: Technically doable. We support importing customer root CAs into node truststores, PKCS#11 HSM adapters, and offline cert rotation (CSR generated on node -> customer signs -> reimport). We'll need a step-by-step runbook and acceptance tests.

Tim Park: Proposal for POC artifacts: signed full bundle (OCI tar) + optional delta patches. Each artifact includes detached signature, SBOM, checksum. Add activation token tied to cluster ID so a bundle only activates on authorized hardware. Sample verification snippet to include in runbook:

```
sha256sum redwood-bundle-20250204.tar.gz
gpg --verify redwood-bundle-20250204.tar.gz.sig redwood-bundle-20250204.tar.gz
jq '.components[]|{name,version}' redwood-bundle-20250204.sbom.json
```

ops-bot: Artifact published: rwd-20250204-12 v1.2.0-detached, sha256:fa3b9c..., SBOM attached.

Aisha Khan: Commercial ask: can we promise a 6-month scheduled upgrade cadence in the SOW and emergency CVE patches between windows? Pricing impact?

Tim Park: Major upgrades are opt-in. Guaranteed 6-month forced upgrades would require a managed-service addendum and price uplift. Emergency patches covered by enterprise SLA (72h) as standard. I'll loop in Sales Ops/Legal.

Maya Li: Eng estimate: runbook + offline packaging automation ~ 3 eng-weeks; PKCS#11/HSM adapter + test harness 2-4 weeks depending on vendor; delta-signing pipeline ~ 1 eng-week initial; CA rotation doc ~ 2 days. Recommend a staging dry-run (USB emulation) before the field POC.

Aisha Khan: Action items: Tim -> draft POC runbook and transfer-station checklist by EOD tomorrow. Maya -> vendor compatibility matrix for PKCS#11 + sample CSR rotation runbook. I'll coordinate SOW language with Legal. :thumbsup:

Tim Park: Got it. I'll include operator verification checklist and activation-binding steps.

Maya Li: Also request a brief on-site acceptance test script so customer can sign off on the transfer flow.

Aisha Khan: Thanks team. I'll update thread when runbook is ready.
